cameraoverhaul.config.title: CameraOverhaul: Bodycam Edition Settings
cameraoverhaul.config.configVersion.name: Config Version
cameraoverhaul.config.enabled.name: Enable the mod's effects
cameraoverhaul.config.enabled.desc: Toggles all of the mod's features.
cameraoverhaul.config.enableInThirdPerso: Disable this to make the mod's effects exclusive to first-person view.
cameraoverhaul.config.contextTransitionS: How smooth should transitions between contextual profiles such as walking and swimming be.
cameraoverhaul.config.strafingRollFactor: Strength of the camera roll rotation caused by strafing, or sideway horizontal velocity.
cameraoverhaul.config.forwardVelocityPit: Strength of camera pitch rotations caused by moving forward or backwards.
cameraoverhaul.config.verticalVelocityPi: Strength of camera pitch rotations caused by vertical velocity.
cameraoverhaul.config.horizontalVelocity: Smoothness of camera pitch & roll rotations caused by moving horizontally.
cameraoverhaul.config.verticalVelocitySm: Smoothness of camera pitch rotations caused by moving vertically.
cameraoverhaul.config.cameraSmoothing.de: Controls global interpolation of the camera's pitch & yaw. Does not affect gameplay (aim).
cameraoverhaul.config.turningRollAccumul: Sensitivity of the camera roll rotation caused by turning around horizontally.
cameraoverhaul.config.turningRollIntensi: Maximum strength of the camera roll rotation caused by turning around horizontally.
cameraoverhaul.config.turningRollSmoothi: Smoothness of the decay of the camera roll rotation caused by turning around horizontally.
cameraoverhaul.config.cameraSwayIntensit: Strength of smooth random sway that kicks in when the player idles for enough time.
cameraoverhaul.config.cameraSwayFrequenc: Frequency of smooth random sway that kicks in when the player idles for enough time.
cameraoverhaul.config.cameraSwayFadeInDe: Amount of time that the player must idle for before smooth random sway starts to fade-in.
cameraoverhaul.config.cameraSwayFadeInLe: Amount of time it takes for smooth random sway to fade-in after the player idles for enough time.
cameraoverhaul.config.cameraSwayFadeOutL: Amount of time it takes for smooth random sway to fade-out when the player starts moving after idling.
cameraoverhaul.config.screenShakesMaxInt: Maximum strength of all screen shaking effects.
cameraoverhaul.config.screenShakesMaxFre: Speed at which screen shaking rotations change direction or oscillate.
cameraoverhaul.config.explosionTrauma.de: A [0..1] value linked to the strength of screen shaking caused by explosions.
cameraoverhaul.config.thunderTrauma.name: Thunder Screen Shake Trauma
cameraoverhaul.config.thunderTrauma.desc: A [0..1] value linked to the strength of screen shaking caused by lightning bolt-tied thunder.
cameraoverhaul.config.handSwingTrauma.de: A [0..1] value linked to the strength of screen shaking caused by any actions that swing the player's arm. Best kept very low.
cameraoverhaul.config.gaitIntensity.name: Walking Gait Intensity
cameraoverhaul.config.gaitIntensity.desc: Strength of the head sway tied to footsteps. Steps are timed to the distance you travel. Consider turning off vanilla View Bobbing to avoid doubling up.
cameraoverhaul.config.gaitCycleLength.de: Blocks travelled per full stride (left + right step). Larger values mean slower, longer steps.
Blocks travelled per full stride (left + right step). Larger values mean slower, longer steps. Only used when Follow Player Model is off.
cameraoverhaul.config.landingImpactInten: Strength of the head dip and wobble when landing after a jump or fall. Scales with fall speed.
Strength of the small head kick when pushing off the ground.
cameraoverhaul.config.accelerationLeanIn: How much the head lags behind when you start, stop, or change direction, overshooting slightly before settling.
cameraoverhaul.config.breathingIntensity: Strength of the subtle rise and fall of the view from breathing.
cameraoverhaul.config.fatigueIntensity.d: How much sprinting for a while leaves you winded, with heavier breathing and a larger gait.
cameraoverhaul.config.handheldTremorInte: Strength of the tiny constant shake of a living head that is never perfectly still.
cameraoverhaul.config.mountShakeIntensit: Strength of the hoofbeat bounce and rumble while riding a horse or other mount. It grows with speed, so a gallop shakes the most. 0 turns it off.
cameraoverhaul.config.fallShakeIntensity: Strength of the flailing and wind buffeting while falling. It grows with fall speed, so long drops shake the most. 0 turns it off.
cameraoverhaul.config.heartbeatIntensity: Strength of the faint heartbeat thump in the camera. It quickens and gets stronger as sprinting leaves you winded. 0 turns it off.
Strength of the tilt towards the planted foot on every step, and of leaning into turns while running. 0 turns it off.
cameraoverhaul.config.terrainLeanIntensi: Strength of the lean when your feet go up or down, such as climbing stairs (forward) or descending them (back). 0 turns it off.
cameraoverhaul.config.gaitFollowsModel.d: Times the footsteps and sets their size from the player model's own leg animation, so camera steps match the legs you see. Turn off to time steps by distance travelled instead.
cameraoverhaul.config.walkShakeIntensity: How much footsteps shake the camera while walking. 1 is the full original strength, lower is calmer, 0 turns it off.
cameraoverhaul.config.sprintShakeIntensi: How much footsteps shake the camera while sprinting. 1 is the full original strength, lower is calmer, 0 turns it off.
cameraoverhaul.config.bodycamEnabled.des: Makes the camera behave as if strapped to your chest: harsher footstep jolts, a camera that trails behind where you look, stronger breathing, and no tremor.
cameraoverhaul.config.bodycamIntensity.d: Overall strength of bodycam mode. 1.0 is full bodycam, 0 behaves like normal first person, values up to 2 exaggerate it.
cameraoverhaul.config.bodycamTorsoLag.de: How much the view trails behind your mouse movement, like a torso following the head. Does not affect aim.
cameraoverhaul.config.bodycamStepJolt.de: Strength of the sharp jolt on every footstep. Scales with speed and is heaviest when sprinting.
